ai_report.overall_summary_short: Multiple micronutrient deficiencies detected. Pre-diabetic indicators present. Immediate dietary intervention recommended.
ai_report.clinical_interpretation: Rahul presents with iron-deficiency anaemia (Hb 11.2, Ferritin 8, MCV 72). Fasting glucose 105 + HbA1c 5.9% confirms pre-diabetic range. Vitamin D is severely deficient at 14 ng/mL, directly impacting muscle synthesis, testosterone, and immunity. Zinc deficiency compounds hormonal concerns. Cross-referencing nutrition data: protein at 68g/day is severely below the 140–160g required for muscle gain. The diet is dominated by high-glycaemic refined carbohydrates explaining borderline glucose and triglycerides.

foods_avoid.reason: High GI — spikes glucose. Switch to small portions + brown rice or millets.

foods_avoid.name: White Bread / Maida products
foods_avoid.reason: Refined carbs elevate triglycerides and worsen pre-diabetic pattern.

foods_avoid.name: Tea / Coffee with meals
foods_avoid.reason: Tannins reduce iron absorption by up to 70%. Avoid 1 hour around iron-rich meals.

foods_avoid.name: Sweetened beverages
foods_avoid.reason: Fructose directly raises triglycerides. Replace with water + lime.

foods_avoid.name: Fried snacks
foods_avoid.reason: Trans fats raise LDL and increase cardiovascular risk.

lifestyle.sleep: Target 7.5–8.5 hours. Iron deficiency impairs sleep quality. Avoid screens 1 hour before bed. Magnesium glycinate 200mg before sleep improves muscle recovery.
lifestyle.stress: Cortisol near upper limit. Chronic stress worsens glucose and impairs iron absorption. 10–15 min daily breathwork or meditation recommended.
lifestyle.exercise: Moderate resistance training 4x/week. Avoid high-intensity until Hb reaches 12.5 g/dL — anaemia limits oxygen delivery. Prioritise compound lifts: squats, rows, deadlifts.
lifestyle.hydration: Minimum 3–3.5 litres/day. Supports blood viscosity, kidney filtration, and reduces false glucose elevation.
lifestyle.recovery: Post-workout: consume iron + protein meal within 60 minutes. Vitamin C must accompany iron meals. Avoid tea/coffee within 1 hour of meals.
